NOVEMBER 2026

Twenty members. One shared pool.

ICONS 20

A message from the Executive Committee

Ten months ago, twenty friends
made one simple promise:
save together, grow together.

Every month, every member showed up. We collected on time, invested every dirham, completed our kuri cycle and built our first portfolio: gold, bank deposits and secured financing. All tangible. All in the UAE.

That first year was about trust and discipline, and it worked. Now we are ready for the next chapter: a broader, stronger portfolio, a clear place for real estate in India and the UAE, and one shared goal: a portfolio we own and a fund we manage by 2031.

This document is not about detail. It is about where we are going, and why we believe we will get there together.

Together, always.

Real estateCo-investment

Bigger deals, together.
